By default CADET produces certificates that can be checked by Certcheck, which was written by [Leander Tentrup](https://www.react.uni-saarland.de/people/tentrup.html). Certcheck comes with the distribution of [CAQE](https://www.react.uni-saarland.de/tools/caqe/). To produce certificates that are compatible with [QBFcert](http://fmv.jku.at/qbfcert/) add `--qbfcert` option to the command line.
